recording_provenance.selection: One reviewed recording per CS-01 through CS-15
recording_provenance.review_process: Reviewed recordings were supplied by a second clinical recording team
recording_provenance.case_type: Simulated clinical scenarios; no real patient cases or patient-identifying information
recording_provenance.authorized_use: Approved for benchmarking, error analysis, and terminology improvement; not evidence from real patients
recording_provenance.raw_audio_storage: Local approved validation folder; not included in this repository

interpretation.note: Exact target-term scoring treats spelling, inflection, and terminology substitutions as misses. Clinicians must review medication, dose, allergy, pregnancy, pediatric, and emergency terms before any care action.

privacy.raw_transcripts_and_provider_file_ids: Excluded from repository unless separately needed for private evaluation
privacy.consent_and_provenance_records: No patient consent is required for the simulated cases; recording-team provenance is retained locally
